import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Plot sales by product over time
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))
sns.barplot(x='date', y='total', hue='product', data=coffee_sales)
plt.title('Daily Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.legend(title='Product')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Explore distribution of total sales
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(coffee_sales['total'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Total Sales')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot sales by customer age group
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(x='customer_age_group', y='total', data=coffee_sales)
plt.title('Sales by Customer Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
